metric_identity: Average Model Calls to Commit Execution Route

route_contract_classes.REQUIRED: A successful conformant episode requires every domain-execution subgoal route to be operationally committed.
route_contract_classes.OPTIONAL: The scenario contract permits either a valid route commit or a safe terminal resolution without a route.
route_contract_classes.FORBIDDEN: No domain-execution route is authorized; a commit is a contract violation.

primary_observation_rule.calls_to_route_commit: Count ORCHESTRATION or MIXED logical generations from request-processing start through the final required route commit.

primary_comparability_qualification.population: all predeclared QA-04-eligible ROUTE_REQUIRED episodes in the comparison stratum
primary_comparability_qualification.pass_rule: Every required episode has ROUTE_COMMITTED status, a numeric observation, and QA-02 exact conformance.
primary_comparability_qualification.failure_effect: Do not produce or compare a qualified primary aggregate for that alternative/stratum; retain numeric observations only as diagnostics.

forbidden_handling.committed: ROUTE_FORBIDDEN_BUT_COMMITTED contract violation; never a primary resource observation

arbitrary_numeric_penalty.reason: An invented call count changes resource units and mixes correctness into QA-04.
